==================
Comment after a value without a semicolon
==================

a { x: red // x
}

---

(source (declaration (value (word))) (comment))

==================
Comment after a division without a semicolon
==================

a { x: red / blue // x
}

---

(source (declaration (value (binary (value (word)) (value (word))))) (comment))

==================
A slash inside a word remains part of the value
==================

a { x: /red; }

---

(source (declaration (value (word))))
